Explore the meetings, workshops and training schools attended by our team, former members and collaborators. Each event appears once, with the attendees together; open its contributions to explore individual talks and posters.

[Meet the people](team.qmd) · [Read our publications](publications.qmd) · [Latest group news](../index.qmd)

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
load('../data/bg_df_data.RData')
source('../R/resume_fun.R')
events <- conference_events(full_df %>% filter(activity == 'conferences', !is.na(team), team != 'other'))
conference_cards(events, preview = 8L)
```
